techs.name: Graviton Resonance Pulse
techs.effect: A tuned graviton beam shatters the Crystalline Entity; also breaks up asteroid hazards.

techs.name: Food Replicators
techs.effect: Colonies no longer need food imports.

techs.name: Industrial Replicators
techs.effect: Energy → Tritanium/Duranium at 5:1. Cannot make dilithium or latinum.

techs.name: Dampener-Resistant Power Routing
techs.effect: Ships keep power under Breen energy dampeners.

techs.name: Saucer Separation
techs.effect: Explorer hulls split into a saucer and a battle section.

techs.name: Multi-Vector Assault Mode
techs.effect: A ship splits into three independent attack sections.

techs.name: Programmable Matter
techs.effect: Ships reconfigure module loadout in the field.
